body.p: The journal retracts the article titled “Service Trust and Customer Loyalty in China’s Hotel Services: The Causal Role of Commitment” [1], cited above.

Following publication, concerns were brought to the attention of the Editorial Office regarding an overlap with a previously published article [2] in another language and missing ethical approval information.

In accordance with the journal’s standard procedures, the Editorial Office and Editorial Board conducted an investigation, which identified substantial overlap between this article [1] and a previously published article with a common author [2], including similarities in the research setting, sample size, methodology, and key findings. The investigation also confirmed that the ethical approval information required under MDPI’s Human Research Policy was not reported in the published article [1]. Despite repeated attempts to contact the author and the corresponding institution, no response was received.

Consequently, given the extent of the overlap identified and the absence of the required ethical approval information, the Editorial Board has decided to retract this article in accordance with MDPI’s retraction policy.
This retraction was approved by the Editor-in-Chief of the journal Sustainability.
The author has been informed of this retraction but did not provide a comment on this decision.
